absent: Full write dispatch and return code contract for general VMX register writes beyond the architectural capabilities hook.
Initial values reset behavior and concurrency control for nested capability caches and global nested configuration.
Complete widths offsets and reserved field definitions for nested capability and tracing descriptor storage.
Trust domain emulation predicate details and common register read fallback behavior.
Lifetime teardown and failure recovery for guest branch record perf events beyond creation.
Hardware programming effects and ordering for user return and guest host register caches.

findings.text: Nested capability restore entry refuses any update while the vCPU reports VMX operation active and otherwise dispatches each capability identifier to its dedicated restore routine, rejecting unknown identifiers.

A shared subset predicate checks masked containment between host support and incoming values, and all capability restore paths use it to forbid enabling unsupported features or reserved positions and to preserve required settings.

Basic capability restore validates feature and reserved positions against host support, forbids an inverted polarity address width indicator, requires matching revision identity and non shrinking structure size, then caches the accepted value per vCPU.

True pinbased and procbased controls plus exit and entry controls and secondary procbased controls are restored only when required set positions remain set in the low half and required clear positions remain clear in the high half, after which the halves are cached per vCPU.

Miscellaneous capability restore checks feature and reserved positions against host support, preserves timer rate when the timer is advertised, enforces upper bounds on counts and limits, requires matching management revision, then caches the halves.

Combined extended page table and virtual processor identifier capabilities accept only bits already present in host support and split the result into separate caches, while fixed zero controls for processor control registers require all host required set positions to remain set.

Direct restore is refused for non true control capabilities and for fixed variant capabilities derived from processor identification, while enumeration is cached unconditionally and function controls are cached only when they request no unsupported controls.

Per vCPU nested capability storage holds paired low and high halves for pinbased procbased exit entry secondary and miscellaneous controls, separate extended page table and virtual identifier halves, fixed zero values for control registers, plus basic enumeration and function control fields.

General VMX register read serves segment bases, kernel segment cache, system enter state, control tracing and nested state from hardware or per vCPU caches, consulting a user return table and then common handling when no direct case matches.

Many VMX reads allow host initiated access unconditionally while guest access requires matching capability such as transaction control availability, wait package enablement, speculation control support, protection extension, machine check extension, enclave launch control, nested virtualization, or tracing mode with relevant tracing features.

Top level read dispatch directs trust domain vCPUs to trust domain handling and others to VMX handling, with trust domain handling synthesizing locked feature control with local machine check indication and serving extended machine check control subject to capability before delegating to common handling after an emulation check.

Emulation support reports system management base availability from build configuration and guest mode flexibility, nested range availability from a global nesting flag, negative for certain AMD only identifiers and affirmative otherwise, with trust domain guests using dedicated logic.

Tracing control validation rejects reserved positions, forbids reconfiguration while tracing stays active unless the same update disables it, requires a supported output method when enabling, checks timing and marker encodings against advertised sets, and limits address filter selectors by available range count.
Tracing register writes are allowed only in host guest tracing mode while tracing is inactive, and output base acceptance requires a fixed alignment together with a legal guest physical address.
Tracing interception follows the tracing enable indicator, requesting interception for status output base output mask address match and per range address pairs while tracing is inactive.

An inline helper clears interception for a register and access kind through the general intercept routine, while a different inline helper reports wait package availability from secondary execution controls.

User return and guest host register updates bracket hardware programming with preemption control so the CPU cannot change mid update, refreshing cached values only after successful hardware programming or unconditionally for the guest host path.

User return entries carry a hardware load flag plus mask and cached data, with slot identity derived from position within the per vCPU table, and kernel segment base writes flow through a shared guest host writer that programs hardware when guest state is loaded and updates a cache.
Control and fixed zero selector helpers trap when asked for an identifier outside their known sets, so callers must pass only previously validated capability identifiers.

Feature control validation rejects guest modification once locked and rejects data with bits outside the allowed set, where host initiated accesses use a broader supported set than guest accesses, with a warning when per vCPU valid bits exceed the global supported set.

Supported debug control bits combine bus lock detection, branch record format with performance monitoring enablement, and transactional memory debug support, each gated by boot capability plus host initiation or guest capability, while validation tolerates legacy branch bits with an unimplemented log and rejects other unsupported bits.
System enter address handling narrows width for guests without long mode on wider builds and preserves full width otherwise.

Guest branch record event creation requires a per vCPU descriptor, reuses an existing event while marking the fixed virtual branch resource in use, otherwise creates a pinned host excluded branch stack kernel counter with call stack and user sampling, tracks usage count and resource bit, and propagates creation failure with rate limited logging.
The tail of the general VMX write path refreshes fill buffer clear disable state after handling architectural capabilities and then returns the prior status.

Nested capability identifiers for basic pinbased procbased exit entry secondary miscellaneous fixed extended page table virtual identifier enumeration and function controls are stable ABI values used for restore dispatch.
Tracing register identifiers for control status output base output mask address match and address range pairs are stable ABI values used for read validation and intercept management.
